941: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ. ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
He alone understands whom the Lord Himself makes understand; through the Guru's Word he is liberated.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥੨੫॥
Nanak, the Saviour carries across the one who has cast off ego and duality." ॥25॥
"The self-willed goes astray and falls under Death's sway;
he eyes another's home, and loses again and again.
The self-willed wanders in doubt as if in a wilderness;
gone astray, he is plundered, like one reciting spells at a cremation ground.
He does not recognise the Word, and speaks evil words.
Nanak, know that those dyed in the True One have peace." ॥26॥
"The one turned to the Guru holds the fear of the True One;
through the bani, the one turned to the Guru shapes the unshaped mind;
the one turned to the Guru sings the praises of the Immaculate Lord;
the one turned to the Guru attains the pure, supreme state;
the one turned to the Guru meditates on the Lord with every hair of his body;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru merges in the True One." ॥27॥
"One devoted to the Guru has, as it were, reflected on the Vedas;
devoted to the Guru, one crosses the ocean;
devoted to the Guru, one becomes spiritually wise through the Word;
devoted to the Guru, one knows the way within.
Through the Guru the Unseen, Infinite Lord is found;
Nanak, through the Guru the door of liberation is found." ॥28॥
"The one turned to the Guru speaks of the Indescribable through reflection;
the one turned to the Guru succeeds while living with his family;
through the Guru one chants His Name with love within;
through the Guru one finds Him by the Word and good conduct.
Pierced by the Word, he knows Him and makes others know Him;
Nanak, burning away his ego, he merges in the Lord." ॥29॥
"The True One fashioned the earth for those who turn to the Guru;
ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ; ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
on it He staged the play of creation and destruction.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
One who is dyed in His love through the Guru's Word,
ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤਉ; ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
imbued with the True One, goes home with honour.
ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ; ਪਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Without the true Word, no one obtains honour;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਕਿਉ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੦॥
Nanak, without the Name, how can one merge in the True One?" ॥30॥
"For the one turned to the Guru are the eight powers and all wisdom;
through the Guru one crosses the world-ocean and gains true understanding.
The one turned to the Guru knows good times and bad;
the one turned to the Guru knows what to take up and what to renounce.
The one turned to the Guru carries others across to the far shore;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru saves others through the Word." ॥31॥
dyed in the Name, one remains absorbed in the True One;
dyed in the Name, one reflects on the true way of yoga;
dyed in the Name, one finds the door of liberation;
dyed in the Name, one understands the three worlds;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
Nanak, dyed in the Name, there is everlasting peace." ॥32॥
"Dyed in the Name, there is true dialogue with the siddhas, union with the Lord;
dyed in the Name, there is lasting austerity;
dyed in the Name is the true and most excellent conduct;
dyed in the Name is reflection on His virtues and wisdom.
Without the Name, all that one speaks is useless;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੩॥
Nanak, hail to those dyed in the Name." ॥33॥
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
"From the Perfect Guru the Name is obtained;
the way of yoga is to remain absorbed in the True One.
ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਭਰਮਾਏ; ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਛਿਅ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
The yogis wander in their twelve orders, the sannyasis in their ten.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
One who, through the Guru's Word, dies to self and lives finds the door of liberation.
942: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Without the Word, all are attached to duality; reflect in your heart and see.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਵਡੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩੪॥
Nanak, great and fortunate are those who keep the True One enshrined in their hearts." ॥34॥
"The one turned to the Guru finds the jewel, staying attuned to Him;
the one turned to the Guru naturally appraises the jewel;
the one turned to the Guru practises true deeds;
the mind of the one turned to the Guru is content with the True One.
When it pleases Him, the one turned to the Guru reveals the Unseen to others;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru does not suffer blows." ॥35॥
"For the one turned to the Guru, the Name is charity and cleansing bath;
the one turned to the Guru is intuitively absorbed in meditation;
the one turned to the Guru obtains honour in the Lord's Court,
and meets the Supreme Lord, Destroyer of fear.
The one turned to the Guru inspires others to do good deeds;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru unites others in His union." ॥36॥
"For the one turned to the Guru, his walking in the Guru's way is the Shastras, Simritis and Vedas;
the one turned to the Guru knows the secret of the Lord in every heart;
the one turned to the Guru sheds enmity and opposition;
the one turned to the Guru erases all keeping of accounts against others;
the one turned to the Guru is dyed in the love of the Lord's Name;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru recognises his Master." ॥37॥
"Without the Guru, one wanders, coming and going;
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਘਾਲ. ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
without the Guru, one's efforts are not accepted;
without the Guru, the mind wavers greatly;
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ; ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
without the Guru, one is not satisfied, eating poison;
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਡਸੈ, ਮਰਿ ਵਾਟ ॥
without the Guru, the serpent of Maya stings, and one dies on the way;
Nanak, without the Guru there is loss upon loss." ॥38॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
"The one whom the Guru meets is carried across;
his faults are erased, and through virtue he is saved.
Reflecting on the Guru's Word, he obtains the supreme bliss of liberation.
The one turned to the Guru never comes back defeated.
The body is his little shop, and this mind the trader;
Nanak, with poise he trades in Truth." ॥39॥
"The Creator built the bridge of the one turned to the Guru;
as Lanka was plundered and the demons tormented,
and as Ramchand slew Ravan, so the serpent of the mind is slain;
the Guru's teaching serves as did the secret told by Babhikhan.
The one turned to the Guru carries even stones across the ocean;
through the one turned to the Guru, countless millions are saved." ॥40॥
"For the one turned to the Guru, coming and going ends;
the one turned to the Guru is honoured in the Lord's Court;
the one turned to the Guru distinguishes the false from the genuine;
the one turned to the Guru is intuitively absorbed in meditation;
the one turned to the Guru is absorbed in His praise in the Court;
Nanak, no obstacle blocks the path of the one turned to the Guru." ॥41॥
"The one turned to the Guru obtains the Name of the Immaculate Lord;
the one turned to the Guru burns away ego through the Word;
the one turned to the Guru sings the praises of the True One;
the one turned to the Guru remains absorbed in the True One.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ; ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
Through the True Name, the one turned to the Guru is honoured;
ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੨॥
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru understands all the worlds." ॥42॥
(Siddhas:) "What is the root of all? What age is the time for teaching?
ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
Who is your guru, whose disciple are you?
Nanak says: they asked, "Listen, young boy,
give us your reflection on this:
how does the Word carry us across the world-ocean?" ॥43॥
943: (Guru:) "Breath is the beginning; this is the age of the True Guru's teaching.
The Word is the Guru, and my attuned awareness is the disciple.
Speaking of the Indescribable, I remain detached.
Nanak, through the ages the Lord of the world is the Guru.
It is the One Word through which His praises are reflected on;
the one turned to the Guru puts out the fire of ego." ॥44॥
ਮੈਣ ਕੇ ਦੰਤ; ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
(Siddhas:) "With teeth of wax, how can one chew iron?
ਜਿਤੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ; ਸੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
What is the food that takes away pride?
ਹਿਵੈ ਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਅਗਨਿ ਪਿਰਾਹਨੁ ॥
If one lives in a palace of snow wearing a robe of fire,
in what cave can one remain unshaken?
ਇਤ ਉਤ; ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Knowing whom, here and there, may one be absorbed?
What meditation lets the mind be absorbed in itself?" ॥45॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਮੈ ਮੈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
(Guru:) "One who removes "I, I" and "me, mine" from within,
and erases duality, becomes one with the One.
The world is hard for the foolish self-willed;
by living the Word, one chews the iron.
One who knows the One within and without,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੪੬॥
Nanak, has his fire put out by the Will of the True Guru." ॥46॥
"Imbued with the fear of the True One, he casts off pride;
he knows the One and reflects on the Word.
With the Word within the heart, the True One dwells there;
his body and mind are cooled, dyed in His love.
He puts out the poison of lust and anger and the fire of craving;
Nanak, he is blessed by the Beloved's gracious glance." ॥47॥
ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ; ਚੰਦੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
(Siddhas:) "How does the moon, the house of coolness, cast its light within?
How does the sun of wisdom blaze and shine?
ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ; ਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
How is Death kept from eyeing us daily?
By what understanding is the honour of the one turned to the Guru preserved?
Who is the warrior who slays Death?
Give us your reflection, Nanak," they said. ॥48॥
(Guru:) "Uttering the Word, the infinite light of the moon shines within;
ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਵਸੈ; ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
when the sun dwells in the house of the moon, darkness is dispelled.
ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
Regarding pleasure and pain alike, one makes the Name his support;
the Lord Himself carries him across.
Devoted to the Guru, the mind merges in the True One;
prays Nanak, Death does not consume him." ॥49॥
ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
"The essence of the Name is known to be the highest of all.
Without the Name, pain and Death torment one.
When the essence merges in the Essence, the mind is satisfied;
duality departs, and one comes to dwell in the home of the One.
The breath of divine life blows and the heavens thunder;
Nanak, then union with Him is unshakeable and natural." ॥50॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ. ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ; ਸੁੰਨ ਮਸੁੰਨੰ ॥
"Within is the Absolute, without is the Absolute; the three worlds are filled with the Absolute.
ਚਉਥੇ ਸੁੰਨੈ. ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤਾ ਕਉ. ਪਾਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੰ ॥
One who knows the Lord in the fourth state is not touched by vice or virtue.
ਘਟਿ; ਘਟਿ; ਸੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
One who knows the secret of the Absolute that pervades every heart
becomes one with the Primal Being, the Immaculate Divine Lord.
The humble one who is imbued with the Immaculate Name,
Nanak, becomes one with the Creator Himself." ॥51॥
"Everyone speaks of the Absolute, the stillness;
but how is the unbroken stillness attained?
What are they like who are imbued with the unbroken stillness?
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
They become like the One from whom they came.
ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਹਿ; ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
They are not born, they do not die, they do not come and go;
Nanak, those turned to the Guru instruct their minds." ॥52॥
"When the nine pools are filled to the brim and the tenth is full,
there the unbroken stillness sounds its bugles.
Beholding the True One present, they are absorbed in Him;
the True One pervades every heart.
944: When the hidden bani is revealed,
Nanak, one appraises the True One." ॥53॥
"Meeting Him with intuitive love, there is peace.
The one turned to the Guru stays awake and does not sleep.
The Word of the Absolute keeps him rooted in the Infinite;
chanting it, he is liberated, and through the Word he saves others.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ; ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Those who take the Guru's teaching are dyed in the True One;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ; ਮਿਲਣ. ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੇ ॥੫੪॥
Nanak, shedding self-conceit, they meet Him and are not deluded." ॥54॥
(Siddhas:) "Where is the place where evil-mindedness is cast off?
ਕਿਉ ਤਤੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ; ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
Why does one not understand reality, and suffer blows?
ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
No one can save one bound at Death's door;
without the Word, one has no honour or credit.
How can one understand and cross over?"
Nanak: the foolish self-willed does not understand. ॥55॥
(Guru:) "Evil-mindedness is erased by reflecting on the Guru's Word.
Meeting the True Guru, the door of liberation is found.
ਤਤੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
The self-willed does not recognise reality and is burnt to ashes;
separated by evil-mindedness, he suffers blows.
One who accepts the Command has all virtues and wisdom;
Nanak, he is honoured in the Lord's Court." ॥56॥
"One who has the true merchandise, the wealth of the Name,
crosses over himself and carries others across.
Imbued with poise, he understands and is honoured;
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਰੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
no one can estimate his worth.
Wherever he looks, he sees the Lord pervading;
Nanak, through love of the True One, he crosses over." ॥57॥
ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
(Siddhas:) "Where is the dwelling of that Word by which the terrifying world-ocean is crossed?
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ, ਵਾਈ ਕਹੀਐ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
The breath, it is said, extends ten finger-lengths; what is its support?
ਬੋਲੈ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
How can the soul that speaks and plays become steady, and how can it see the Unseen?"
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ; ਅਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
Nanak prays: "Listen, master": how can one instruct one's own mind?
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ; ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
(Guru:) "Through the Word, the one turned to the Guru is attuned to the True One; casting His glance, the Lord unites him with Himself.
ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫੮॥
He Himself is the Knower and the Seer; by perfect destiny one merges in Him." ॥58॥
ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਲਖੰ; ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
"That Word dwells unbroken everywhere; it is the Unseen Lord; wherever I look, there it is.
ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ. ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ; ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
As the Absolute dwells everywhere, so does the Word; it is the very Lord, the Bearer of all power.
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ. ਸਬਦੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
When He casts His glance, the Word dwells in the heart and drives out doubt from within;
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ; ਨਾਮੋੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
body, mind and speech become pure, and one enshrines the Name in the mind.
ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ. ਭਵਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ; ਇਤ ਉਤ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word one crosses the world-ocean, knowing the One here and hereafter.
ਚਿਹਨੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੫੯॥
Nanak, one who recognises the Word loses all separate mark and colour, and Maya's shadow is gone." ॥59॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਅਉਧੂ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਚੁ ਆਹਾਰੋ ॥
"O yogi, the food of the breath of ten finger-lengths is the True, Absolute Lord.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ; ਚੀਨੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
The one turned to the Guru chants His Name, churns out the essence, and recognises the Unseen, Infinite Lord.
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੈ. ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
When he erases the three qualities and enshrines the Word, ego departs from his mind.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
When he knows the One within and without, he comes to love the Lord's Name.
ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ; ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
He understands the subtle channels of Sukhmana, Ida and Pingala when the Unseen reveals Himself;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹੁ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬੦॥
Nanak, the True One is above all three; through the True Guru's Word one merges in Him." ॥60॥
ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ; ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
(Siddhas:) "The breath is said to be the life of the mind; on what does the breath feed?
ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਅਉਧੂ; ਸਿਧ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
O yogi, what is the way of spiritual wisdom? What does the accomplished siddha earn?"
945: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਰਸੁ, ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ; ਹਉਮੈ ਪਿਆਸ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
(Guru:) "O yogi, without the Word the breath finds no nourishment, and the thirst of ego does not depart.
ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
Those dyed in the Word obtain the ambrosial essence and remain satisfied in the True One."
ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੀਐ; ਕਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥
(Siddhas:) "What understanding keeps the mind steady? What food satisfies it?"
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਕਾਲੁ, ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੬੧॥
(Guru:) "Nanak, through the True Guru, pain and pleasure are seen as alike, and Death does not devour one." ॥61॥
ਰੰਗਿ. ਨ ਰਾਤਾ; ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
"One who is not dyed in His love nor enraptured by His essence,
without the Guru's Word, burns and is consumed.
ਬਿੰਦੁ. ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
He has gained nothing by celibacy if he has not uttered the Word;
ਪਵਨੁ. ਨ ਸਾਧਿਆ; ਸਚੁ. ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
nor by controlling the breath, if he has not worshipped the True One.
ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ; ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
One who speaks of the Indescribable and remains even-minded,
ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੬੨॥
Nanak, finds the Lord, the Soul of all." ॥62॥
"By the Guru's grace one is dyed in His love;
drinking the nectar, one is enraptured with the True One.
Reflecting on the Guru's Word, one puts out the fire within;
drinking the nectar, one finds the peace of the soul.
Worshipping the True One, the one turned to the Guru crosses the ocean;
Nanak, only a rare one who reflects understands this." ॥63॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ. ਕਹਾ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ; ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਇਹੁ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
(Siddhas:) "Where does this mind, like an intoxicated elephant, dwell? Where does the breath dwell?
ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਉਧੂ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਵਨਾ ॥
Where does that Word dwell, O yogi, by which the wandering of the mind ends?"
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ; ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
(Guru:) "When He casts His glance, He leads one to the True Guru, and this mind finds its dwelling in its own home.
ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ. ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
When the mind consumes its own ego it becomes pure, and its running is restrained."
ਕਿਉ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ. ਆਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਕਿਉ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ. ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
(Siddhas:) "How does one recognise the root and know one's own soul? How does the sun merge in the house of the moon?"
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ; ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬੪॥
(Guru:) "The one turned to the Guru removes ego from within; then, Nanak, he merges in poise." ॥64॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੀਅਲੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
"This mind becomes steady and dwells in the heart when, through the Guru, one recognises the root.
ਨਾਭਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
The breath sits in its seat at the navel; searching through the Guru, one finds the essence.
ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਛੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
That Word dwells unbroken in its own home, the Lord; through that Word one finds the Light of the three worlds.
ਖਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ. ਭੂਖ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
Hunger for the True One consumes one's pain, and one remains satisfied in the True One.
ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ; ਬਿਰਲੋ ਕੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ॥
The one turned to the Guru knows the unstruck bani; rare is the one who understands its meaning.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ. ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੈ; ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ. ਕਬਹੂ, ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬੫॥
Nanak says: one who speaks the Truth is dyed in the True One, and this colour never fades." ॥65॥
ਜਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ. ਨ ਹੋਤੀ; ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਕੈਠੈ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
(Siddhas:) "When this heart and body did not exist, where did the mind dwell?
ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ. ਨ ਹੋਤੋ; ਤਾ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
When there was no navel-lotus as a pillar, in which home did the breath rest?
ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ. ਰੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਈ; ਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
When there was no form or feature, on what was the Word attuned?
ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕੀ, ਮੜੀ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ; ਮਿਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
When there was no tomb of blood and semen, how could His extent and worth be known?
ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
When no colour, garb or form could be seen, how could the True One be known?"
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਇਬ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੬੬॥
Nanak: those detached ones dyed in the Name see the True One, ever true, now and always. ॥66॥
ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ. ਨ ਹੋਤੀ, ਅਉਧੂ; ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
(Guru:) "O yogi, when there was no heart or body, the detached mind dwelt in the Absolute.
ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ. ਨ ਹੋਤੋ; ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸਤਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
When there was no navel-lotus as a pillar, the breath dwelt in its own home, in love with the Lord.
ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ. ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ; ਤਉ ਅਕੁਲੀਣਿ ਰਹਤਉ. ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
When there was no form, feature or caste, the sublime Word dwelt in the Lord who has no lineage.
ਗਉਨੁ ਗਗਨੁ ਜਬ ਤਬਹਿ. ਨ ਹੋਤਉ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
When the world and sky did not exist, the Formless One Himself was the Light of the three worlds.
946: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ. ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ; ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
colour, garb and form were in the One alone; there was only the One, the wondrous Word.
ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ. ਸੂਚਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬੭॥
Without the True One no one is pure; Nanak, His story is indescribable." ॥67॥
ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ; ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
(Siddhas:) "O man, how does the world come into being, and by what pain does it perish?"
ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ; ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
(Guru:) "O man, the world comes into being in ego; forgetting the Name, it suffers pain.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
One who turns to the Guru reflects on the essence of wisdom and burns away ego through the Word.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
His body, mind and speech become pure, and he remains absorbed in the True One.
ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
Through the Name he remains detached, keeping the True One enshrined in his heart.
ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ, ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬੮॥
Nanak, without the Name there is never union; reflect in your heart and see." ॥68॥
"Rare is the one turned to the Guru who reflects on the true Word;
to the one turned to the Guru, the True One is revealed through the bani.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
The mind of the one turned to the Guru is drenched with love; rare is the one who understands.
The one turned to the Guru dwells in his own true home.
The one turned to the Guru is the true yogi, who recognises the way.
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru knows the One alone." ॥69॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ; ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
"Without serving the True Guru, there is no union;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
without meeting the True Guru, the Name is not obtained;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
without meeting the True Guru, one suffers great pain;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
without meeting the True Guru, there is the deep darkness of pride.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਮੁਆ. ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੭੦॥
Nanak, without the Guru, one loses one's life and dies." ॥70॥
"The one turned to the Guru conquers his mind by killing ego;
the one turned to the Guru keeps the True One enshrined in his heart;
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ; ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥
the one turned to the Guru conquers the world, crushing and killing Death;
the one turned to the Guru does not come to the Lord's Court defeated.
The one turned to the Guru is united in union, and he alone knows it;
Nanak, the one turned to the Guru recognises the Lord through the Word." ॥71॥
ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
"Listen, O yogi, to the essence of the Word: without the Name there is no yoga.
ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ; ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Those dyed in the Name are enraptured night and day; through the Name comes peace.
ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
Through the Name everything is revealed; through the Name understanding is obtained.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
Without the Name, people wear all sorts of garbs; the True One Himself has led them astray.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
O yogi, the Name is obtained from the True Guru; then the way of yoga is fulfilled.
ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭੨॥
Reflect in your mind and see, Nanak: without the Name there is no liberation." ॥72॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
"O Lord, You alone know Your state and extent; what can anyone say to describe it?
ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤਾ. ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ; ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
You Yourself are hidden and You Yourself manifest; You Yourself enjoy all pleasures.
ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ; ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ ॥
Seekers, siddhas, gurus and many disciples wander searching for You by Your Command.
ਮਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਪਾਇ ਇਹ ਭਿਖਿਆ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
They beg for Your Name, and receiving this alms they are a sacrifice to Your vision.
ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
The Imperishable Lord God has staged this play; the one turned to the Guru understands it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭਿ ਜੁਗ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ; ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭੩॥੧॥
Nanak, He Himself pervades all the ages; there is no other." ॥73॥1॥
947: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥ ਜੋਧੈ ਵੀਰੈ ਪੂਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਸਹਜੈ ਦਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ॥
The True Guru is the field of poise; the one whom the Lord blesses with love for him
ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੇ. ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
sows the Name, the Name sprouts, and he remains absorbed in the Name.
ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਬੀਜੁ ਹੈ; ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਲਾਇ ॥
Ego, the seed of dread, is not in him, and his dread is dispelled.
ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੀਜੇ. ਨ ਉਗਵੈ; ਜੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
He sows no such seed, and none sprouts; he eats what the Lord bestows.
ਅੰਭੈ ਸੇਤੀ. ਅੰਭੁ ਰਲਿਆ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
As water mixed with water cannot be separated again,
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੈ; ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥
so, Nanak, is the wonder of the one turned to the Guru; come and see, O people.
ਲੋਕੁ ਕਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
But what can the poor world see? It has no understanding.
ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
He alone sees, to whom the Lord shows it, in whose mind He dwells. ॥1॥
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
The self-willed is a field of pain; he sows pain and eats pain.
ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ. ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
In pain he is born, in pain he dies; his life passes in "I, I."
ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਸੁਝਈ; ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
He does not see that he is caught in coming and going; the blind one acts in blindness.
ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਦਿਤੇ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
He does not know the One who gives, but clings to what is given.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, he acts according to what is written by past deeds; nothing else can be done. ॥2॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
Meeting the True Guru there is lasting peace; he meets the one whom the Lord Himself unites.
ਸੁਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ; ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The mark of this peace is that one's inner being becomes pure.
ਅਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ; ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
The doubt of ignorance is cut away, and spiritual wisdom is obtained.
ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ; ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
Nanak, the One alone is seen; wherever I look, there He is. ॥3॥
ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ; ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
The True Lord has made this world His throne, a place to sit.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
Everything is He Himself; this the Guru's Word has proclaimed.
ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ; ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
He Himself fashioned creation and made it His mansions and dwellings.
ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਚਾਨਣੇ; ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
The sun and moon are its two lamps; He has made the whole design perfect.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
He Himself sees and Himself hears; through the Guru's Word He is meditated on. ॥1॥
ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ; ਤੂ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Wonderful, wonderful, O True King; true is Your glory. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ; ਆਪੁ ਪੀਸਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਇ ॥
Kabir: I ground myself again and again into henna and toiled;
ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ. ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
but You, my Husband, did not ask after me, nor ever placed me at Your feet. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਆ; ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
Nanak, He Himself has made us into henna; when the Husband casts His glance,
ਆਪੇ ਪੀਸੈ. ਆਪੇ ਘਸੈ; ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲਾਇ ਲਏਇ ॥
He Himself grinds, He Himself rubs, and He Himself applies it to His feet.
ਇਹੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
This cup of love belongs to the Master; He gives it to whomever He pleases. ॥2॥
ਵੇਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ; ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ, ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
He created the varied world; all come and go and merge by His Command.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ; ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
He Himself beholds it and rejoices; there is no other.
ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
As it pleases You, keep us, O Lord; through the Guru's Word You give understanding.
ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਹੀ ॥
All draw their strength from You; as You please, You make them walk.
ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡ. ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
I see none as great as You; of whom could I say it? ॥2॥
ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ; ਫਾਵੀ ਹੋਈ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
Deluded by doubt I wandered the whole world, and wore myself out searching;
948: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਨ ਦੇਵਈ; ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
but the Husband does not give peace this way; what power have we over Him?
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
By the Guru's grace the Lord is meditated on and kept enshrined in the heart.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ. ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, sitting at home I found my Husband when the Creator showed mercy. ॥1॥
ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ; ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
The self-willed passes the day running after worldly affairs, and wastes the night in sleep.
ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
Speaking lies, he eats poison, and departs weeping.
ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਹੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
Death's club hangs over his head; in love of duality he loses his honour.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
He never remembered the Lord's Name, so he comes and goes again.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
By the Guru's grace, in whose mind the Lord dwells, Death's club does not strike.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ; ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, he remains in poise, which is obtained by His grace. ॥2॥
ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤੀ ॥
Some He has attached to His praise, giving them the True Guru's teaching;
ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ. ਨਾਉ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ; ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੀ ॥
on some the eternal Lord has bestowed His eternal Name.
ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ॥
Air, water and fire perform His worship by obeying His Command;
ਏਨਾ ਨੋ ਭਉ ਅਗਲਾ; ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਤੀ ॥
they hold Him in great awe; perfect is the design He has made.
ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
The One Command pervades all; obeying it, peace is found. ॥3॥
ਕਬੀਰ. ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ; ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Kabir: the Lord's touchstone is such that no false one can pass it.
ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੈ; ਜੋ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
He alone passes the Lord's test who has died to the world and lives in God. ॥1॥
ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
How can this mind be killed? How can it die to worldly pleasures?
ਕਹਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਮਾਨਈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one accepts the Word when told, nor gives up ego.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੈ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
By the Guru's grace ego departs, and one becomes liberated while alive.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, whom He forgives attains it, and no obstacle blocks his way. ॥2॥
ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ; ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
Everyone speaks of dying while alive, but how is liberation while living attained?
ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ. ਜੇ ਕਰੇ; ਦਾਰੂ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏਇ ॥
If one takes the restraint of His fear and applies the medicine of His love,
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ; ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ. ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇਇ ॥
and night and day sings His praises in peace and poise, through the Name he crosses the poisonous world-ocean.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
Nanak, it is obtained through the Guru by the one on whom He casts His glance. ॥3॥
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
He created the love of duality and the play of the three qualities.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, who act according to His Command.
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਕੀ; ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
Pandits and astrologers read, but do not understand His reflection.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
All is Your play, O True Creator.
ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
Whomever You please, You forgive, and he merges in You through the true Word. ॥4॥
One who is false in mind practises falsehood;
he runs after Maya, yet calls himself a penitent.
Deluded by doubt, he visits all the pilgrim places;
ਓਹੁ ਤਪਾ; ਕੈਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
how can such a penitent attain the supreme state?
By the Guru's grace, one who lives the Truth,
Nanak, is the true penitent who attains liberation within. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਤਪਾ; ਜਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
He alone is a penitent who practises this penance:
he meets the True Guru and cherishes the Word.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Service to the True Guru — this penance is approved.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਤਪਾ; ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak, such a penitent obtains honour in the Lord's Court. ॥2॥
ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ; ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ॥
He created night and day for the workings of the world;
949: through the Guru's teaching there is light in the heart, dispelling darkness.
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ; ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ॥
By His Command He fashioned all; He pervades every forest and blade of grass.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿ ॥
He Himself is everything; through the Guru, ever chant the Lord's Name.
ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ; ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੫॥
Through the Word understanding comes; the True One Himself gives it. ॥5॥
ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
Those whose minds wander in doubt are not called holy guests;
ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
Nanak, giving to them brings only such merit.
ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੂਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
The supreme state is the fearless, immaculate Lord; one who hungers for Him —
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, rare is the one who gives such a person his food. ॥1॥
ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ; ਜਿ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Those are not called holy guests who eat in others' homes
ਉਦਰੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਪਣੇ; ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
and wear many garbs for the sake of their bellies.
ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
Nanak, they alone are holy guests who journey within the self,
ਭਾਲਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
who search and find their Husband, and dwell in their own true home. ॥2॥
ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ; ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
He separated sky and earth, and within them the True One rules.
ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Every home and door is His true dwelling, where the True Name abides.
ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
His true Command pervades all; through the Guru one merges in the True One.
ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾ; ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
True is He Himself, true His throne; seated there He dispenses true justice.
ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
The Truest of the true pervades all; through the Guru the Unseen is seen. ॥6॥
ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
In the ocean of the world dwells the Infinite Lord; the false come and go.
ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਆਪਣੈ; ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
One who walks by his own will suffers great punishment.
ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ; ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
Everything is in this ocean, but it is obtained by His grace.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, the nine treasures are obtained if one walks in His Will. ॥1॥
ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ; ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
One who did not serve the True Guru with faith wasted his life in ego, born only to perish.
ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਨ ਚਖਿਓ; ਕਮਲੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
His tongue did not taste the Lord's essence, and the lotus of his heart did not blossom.
ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
The self-willed ate poison and died; he was ruined by attachment to Maya.
ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
Without the Name of the One Lord, cursed is such a life, cursed such a dwelling.
ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ; ਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
When the True Lord Himself casts His glance, one becomes the servant of His servants;
ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ; ਕਬਹਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
then night and day he serves the True Guru, and never leaves his side.
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ. ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ; ਤਿਉ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
As the lotus remains untouched in the water, so he remains detached in his household.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
Servant Nanak: all do as they are made to do, as it pleases the Lord, the Treasure of virtues. ॥2॥
ਛਤੀਹ ਜੁਗ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਸਾ; ਆਪੇ ਗਣਤ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
For thirty-six ages there was utter darkness; then He Himself reflected and planned.
ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ; ਆਪਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
He Himself fashioned the whole creation and Himself gave understanding.
ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ; ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਨੀ ॥
He created the Simritis and Shastras, and through them the reckoning of vice and virtue.
ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਨੀ ॥
He alone understands whom the Lord makes understand, and his mind is convinced by the true Word.
ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
He Himself pervades all, and Himself forgives and unites. ॥7॥
ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਤੰਨੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
This body is all blood; without blood the body cannot exist.
ਜੋ ਸਹਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੈ; ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ. ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Those imbued with their Husband have no blood of greed in their bodies.
ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ; ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Living in the fear of God the body grows lean, and the blood of greed leaves it.
950: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ; ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
As metal is purified in fire, so the fear of the Lord removes the filth of evil-mindedness.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, beautiful are those who are dyed in the Lord's love. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮਕਲੀ. ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Through Raag Ramkali, if the Lord dwells in her mind, then her adornment is fruitful.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ; ਤਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
When the lotus of the heart blossoms through the Guru's Word, she is given the treasure of devotion.
ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
When doubt departs she awakens, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.
ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
The one who loves the Lord is blessed with supreme beauty.
ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
The glorious bride ever remembers her Husband.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
The self-willed do not know how to adorn themselves; they will depart, having lost their whole life.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ. ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਨਿਤ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Those who adorn themselves without devotion to the Lord are born again and again in misery.
ਸੈਸਾਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੋਭ. ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ; ਅਗੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ, ਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
They find no glory in this world, and what happens to them hereafter, the Creator knows.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਦੁਹੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Nanak, the One alone is true; the world is caught between birth and death.
ਚੰਗੈ ਮੰਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਸੋ ਕਰਨਿ. ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
He Himself has attached people to good and evil; they do what the Creator makes them do. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸਾਂਤਿ, ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
Without serving the True Guru, peace does not come; there is no other place to find it.
ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ; ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
However much one may long for it, without good destiny the Guru is not found.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
With the vice of greed within, one is led astray by love of duality.
ਤਿਨ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ. ਨ ਚੁਕਈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Their birth and death do not end; in ego they suffer pain.
ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Those who fix their minds on the True Guru — none of them goes empty.
ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
They are not summoned by Death, nor do they suffer pain.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Nanak, those turned to the Guru are saved; they merge in the true Word. ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ; ਹੋਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
He Himself remains ever detached; all others run after worldly affairs.
ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ; ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
He Himself is eternal and unmoving; the others come and go.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Forever and ever meditate on the Lord; those turned to the Guru find peace.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਚਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
One finds a dwelling in one's own true home, and merges in the True One through praise.
ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥
The True One is deep and profound; He makes this understood through the Guru's Word. ॥8॥
ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ; ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
Meditate on the True Name; the True One pervades all.
ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ; ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
Nanak, one who understands His Command obtains the true fruit.
ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ; ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
One who goes about merely talking does not understand the True Command.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ, ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ; ਵਿਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ. ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak, one who accepts the Lord's Will is a devotee; without accepting it, one is utterly false. ॥1॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
The self-willed do not know how to speak; within them are lust, anger and ego.
ਓਇ ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਉਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
They do not know the proper place from the improper; within them is the vice of greed.
ਓਇ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰਹਿ; ਓਨਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
Wherever they come and sit, they talk for their own ends; the terrifying Messenger of Death strikes them down.
ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ; ਮਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
Hereafter, when the account is called for in the Court, the false are beaten and disgraced.
ਏਹ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ. ਕਿਉ ਉਤਰੈ; ਕੋਈ ਕਢਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
How can this filth of falsehood be removed? Let someone reflect on this.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ; ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
If one meets the True Guru, he implants the Name, which cuts away all sins.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ. ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
One who chants the Name and worships the Name — let all bow to such a person.
